title: Quarterly Launch Sentinel and Capacity Decision Hub
creator: Riley Chen
description:
Objective: Build a lightweight operational 'Sentinel' and Decision Hub that centralizes per-release capacity signals, risk scores, cross-surface readiness, and a single source of truth for go/no-go decisions across runtime, console, and API launches.

Background: Recent rollouts have shown recurrence of three failure modes: (1) underestimated GPU capacity contention on Dedicated pools, (2) mismatched canary success criteria between Console and Runtime teams, and (3) unclear escalation ownership when regional capacity dips. This work synthesizes capacity telemetry, launch calendar lanes, and a priority scoring model into a concise dashboard and runbook that on-call and PMs can use during launch windows.

Scope:
- Design a scoring model (Sentinel Score) combining capacity headroom, canary pass rate, error-rate delta, and latency tail to produce a single readiness rating per release cohort.
- Implement a Decision Hub view in Console (read-only for most users) that shows: Sentinel Score, contributing signals, recommended action (Proceed / Delay / Rollback), and links to associated runbooks and PRs.
- Sketch and ship a simple automation: if Sentinel Score falls below threshold X for > 5m, notify launch-ops channel and trigger the recommended mitigation checklist.
- Publish a go/no-go checklist template and escalation matrix for region owners, runtime infra, and SE/ Solutions Eng.
- Keep surface integrations light: surface runtime metrics (token latency P95/P99, KV cache hit ratio), Dedicated capacity pool headroom, Console API error rate, and scheduled launch lane.

Out of scope: full automation for rollback, multi-tenant policy enforcement, and extending Sentinels to private on-prem installs (follow-up work).

Deliverables:
- Product PRD: Confluence link https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LO/Launch+Sentinel+PRD
- Console Decision Hub mockups: Figma link https://www.figma.com/file/launch-sentinel-mockups
- Minimal service to compute Sentinel Score (alpha): repo PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-sentinel/pull/12
- Runbook and escalation matrix: Google Doc https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/launch-sentinel-runbook

Acceptance criteria:
- Sentinel Score computed and surfaced for >= 2 active release lanes (runtime + console).
- Console view loads in <2s and displays contributing signals with links.
- Automation posts to #launch-ops when threshold breached and opens a PagerDuty incident for P1 releases.
- Stakeholder sign-off from runtime, console, infra, and oncall leads.

Success metrics (first quarter post-launch):
- Mean decision latency reduced from 18m to <7m during launch windows.
- Number of last-minute rollbacks due to capacity surprises reduced by 50%.

Stakeholders: Aisha Patel (PM lead), Diego Morales (Runtime Eng lead), Samira Khan (Console Eng), Priya Nair (SRE oncall), Design consult: Elio Gomez.

Notes on privacy/compliance: No customer PII ingested; capacity metrics are aggregated. If any customer-specific telemetry is later needed, we will require security_review_required=true and a scoped data processing agreement.
